text:
Maya (Design): quick a11y sweep on the model details flyout. spotted a few keyboard/focus and contrast nits.

Leo (Eng): what did you see?

Maya (Design): 1) focus outline is invisible on the 'Duplicate model' tertiary action, 2) pill tags (tiny 10px) use purple on white and fail 4.5:1, 3) screen reader reads the same heading twice when opening via keyboard.

Hana (A11y): likely causes: outline suppressed with `:focus { outline: none }`, pills using brand 600 at 10px will fail, and duplicated heading usually from a visible <h3> plus `aria-label` on container.

ops-bot: axe quick summary on /models/: model-details-flyout 
- color-contrast: .tag--small (FAIL)
- focus-visible: .btn--tertiary (no visible focus)
- duplicate-accessible-name: flyout-heading (possible)

Leo (Eng): easy wins: re-enable focus-visible for keyboard only, change tertiary to use token color `neutral-700` on white and add a 2px focus ring with offset. I'll also remove duplicate aria-label.

Maya (Design): for the pills I'll update tokens: either increase bg to brand-700 or switch to white text bold 600 on brand-600; I'll add alt hover/focus states in the spec.

Hana (A11y): test plan: NVDA/VO open flyout, tab through all actions, ensure focus ring on Duplicate, confirm pills meet 4.5:1 at 10px or switch to >= 14px or bold white. Also run axe on staging after patch.

Leo (Eng): I'll push a small PR tomorrow: disable `outline:none`, add `:focus-visible` ring, adjust pill color, and remove redundant aria attributes.

Maya (Design): dropping a Figma note with exact color tokens and sizes.

ops-bot: branch created: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4924 linked UX-2233. Automated checks scheduled.

Hana (A11y): one more nit: when the flyout opens with keyboard, ensure focus lands on the close button and that a `role=dialog` has `aria-modal=true`. Otherwise keyboard users can interact with background.

Leo (Eng): good catch. I'll set initial focus to close on open and add `aria-modal`.

Maya (Design): thanks all — this looks small enough for the next patch. Ping me when PR is up and I'll validate the visual spec. :thumbsup:
